categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies outbound peer connection management in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents outbound full-relay slots from being consumed by peers that decline transaction relay, ensuring nodes maintain sufficient outbound transaction-relay capacity outside of IBD. Addresses longstanding issues (#16418 and #28371) where blocksonly peers degrade transaction broadcast topology without operator knowledge.
